obernants.domain: Documented admitted API and ordered validation errors
obernants.observation_scope: Return values, explicit state and named assertions
obernants.operator: Universe: (raw vector, modulus, result, final vector). For admitted calls any final coefficient incongruent to the literal submask sum, changed length, or residue >=m is absent. Invalid calls paired with Ok or a changed vector are absent. Ordered errors are ZeroModulus, Empty, NotPowerOfTwo, TooLong.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived mathematical target; finite correspondence, not a proof
obernants.assumptions: Lawful ordering where applicable; stated numeric bounds; no allocator fault injection

obernants.operator: For fixed admitted n,m, normalized y has exactly one normalized preimage given by subset Mobius inversion. Raw u64 preimages are all vectors congruent coordinatewise to that preimage; [0] and [m] share output when representable. Unknown modulus or errors enlarge fibers; m=1 sends all raw vectors of fixed length to zero.
